summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing daily ASX reports tied to its previously authorized $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A and Class B common stock. No new authorization, price, premium, or transaction terms were set; exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 merely reproduce buyback disclosures provided to the Australian Securities Exchange. Buybacks occur from time to time and depend on market conditions. This is ordinary capital-return program reporting rather than a special situation; watch only aggregate repurchase pace and any future program expansion.
